## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`paginate` validates `offset` but not `limit`, so a negative limit silently drops the oldest orders instead of raising an error. That gap is the main fix needed.

## Changes
This pull request adds `app/paging.py` with a `paginate(items, limit, offset=0)` helper and gives `list_orders` an optional `limit` that caps the newest-first result. It also adds one test for the capped listing.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/paging.py:12 — correctness — Reject negative limit as offset already does — `list_orders(orders, limit=-1)` returns every order except the oldest instead of raising. `stop = start + limit` becomes `-1` and `items[0:-1]` drops the last element, but lines 9–10 reject only a negative `offset`. — A caller that passes -1 as a "no limit" sentinel or forwards an unchecked request value gets an incomplete listing without any error. — Fix: Add `if limit is not None and limit < 0: raise ValueError("limit must be non-negative")` next to the existing offset check.

## Suggestions
- app/orders.py:6 — correctness — Should list_orders accept offset to reach later pages? — `list_orders(orders, limit=2)` can only ever return the two newest orders. The function does not accept or forward `offset`, so the third and fourth orders cannot be retrieved even though the `paginate` docstring at app/paging.py:7 says "offset lets a caller fetch later pages." — Callers of the order listing get only the first page, which may not meet the pagination asked for in the linked issue. — Fix: Add an `offset=0` parameter and pass it through as `paginate(ordered, limit, offset)`, unless issue #12 asks only for a cap.
- app/paging.py:9 — tests — Cover paginate's offset slicing and negative-offset error — No test calls `paginate` with `offset > 0` or `offset < 0`. The only added test reaches `paginate` through `list_orders` with the default offset of 0, so line 11's slice start and the `ValueError` on line 10 are never run. — A regression in later-page slicing or in negative-offset validation would pass the test suite. — Fix: Add `tests/test_paging.py` cases for a non-zero offset and for a negative offset that raises `ValueError`.

## Not reviewed
- Issue #12, which the pull-request body says this change closes, was not available in the checkout, so this review could not confirm the required pagination behavior.
